message.reasoning_content: George Martin produced all Beatles songs... including all four. All were produced by George Martin (Let It Be album had Glyn Johns/Phil Spector, but Martin produced? "One After 909", "Dig a Pony", "I've Got a Feeling" were Let It Be—produced by George Martin officially? Actually Let It Be album credited to George Martin on later editions. Honey Pie definitely Martin. Pick Honey Pie, high probability.
